core_obligations: Set up the induction on the rank and treat ranks 0 and 1 (proof lines 9420-9423).
Construct the proper morphism X' -> X from a section over a trivialising open U (proof lines 9424-9446).
Read the two-step filtration of f^*E with invertible quotient (proof lines 9446-9448).
Apply the induction hypothesis to the kernel and compose the modifications (proof lines 9448-9449).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a finite locally free module E on an integral scheme X there is a modification f : X' -> X such that f^*E has a filtration with invertible successive quotients (source lines 9412-9418). The proof is an induction on the rank: it forms P = P(E), uses the canonical surjection pi^*E -> O_P(1) with finite locally free kernel of rank r-1, takes the scheme theoretic image X' of a section over a trivialising open U (integral, proper over X and an isomorphism over U, hence a modification), reads off the two-step filtration and applies the induction hypothesis to the kernel.
